company.name: Trayd
company.shortDescription: Trayd is a back office operating system that focuses on HR, payroll, and compliance, streamlining workflows for construction companies.
company.description: Trayd is a construction-focused back-office platform that supports payroll, workforce management, and operational coordination for contractors. The platform combines HR management, onboarding, benefits administration, and employee record tracking within a single system, while also supporting scheduling, dispatch, and crew allocation across job sites. It includes labor tracking tools that capture time, shift activity, and field data, enabling visibility into workforce activity and job progress. Trayd also delivers payroll processing designed for complex labor environments, including union requirements, wage rules, and multi-state compliance considerations. The system generates reports and dashboards that consolidate payroll, attendance, and labor cost data, allowing users to monitor project spending and produce certified payroll documentation. In addition, it supports expense tracking, paid time-off requests, and worker onboarding workflows through digital interfaces.
